patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (slurring) My wife says my smile went crooked and my right arm stopped cooperating. We were doing the crossword about an hour ago when it started.
presentation.triageNote: 72-year-old man with sudden right facial droop, right arm weakness, and slurred speech. His wife reports that he was last known well approximately one hour ago while doing a crossword.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because signs of an acute stroke without a current need for a lifesaving intervention are a high-risk presentation.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is a high-risk, time-sensitive focal neurologic presentation requiring immediate evaluation even though the vital signs do not show respiratory or circulatory collapse.
clinical.acuityReason: Sudden unilateral facial and arm weakness with dysarthria and a last-known-well time of approximately one hour creates a threat to brain function and a narrow treatment window.
keyFindings: Last known well approximately one hour ago
Elevated blood pressure without presented hypoperfusion
teachingPoints: Normal oxygenation and heart rate do not make a new focal neurologic deficit safe to wait.
Brain imaging is diagnostic rather than itself a lifesaving intervention, but the narrow treatment window still requires rapid evaluation.

possibleDiagnoses: Hypoglycemia or another metabolic stroke mimic
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: A stroke alert would prompt immediate glucose testing and brain imaging, followed by time-sensitive neurologic treatment and monitored admission if an acute cerebrovascular event is identified.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 72-year-old man in a cardigan, newspaper folded on his lap
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, right arm drifting limp off the armrest
aiImageGeneration.expression: confused, one side of the mouth drooping
signs: right arm hanging weak and low
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: alert but with an obvious new focal deficit
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 72-year-old man in a cardigan with a folded newspaper on his lap, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting, right arm drifting limp off the armrest. Expression: mildly confused, the right side of his mouth drooping — NOT a grimace. Clearly visible: right-sided facial droop, right arm hanging weak and low. Overall alert but with an obvious new one-sided weakness. No text, no logos.
